record.summary: The render matches the reference apart from the accepted disabled Text size control and its "Coming soon" note.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Text size: the control is disabled (muted labels) and its line under it says "Coming soon" in place of "Scales the whole app: Small 87.5 %, Default 100 %, Large 112.5 %." (step D adds text size later). On a narrow screen the one-line note makes every section below it sit about one text line higher.
accepted_deviations.note: The Small, Default and Large labels are muted and the note reads "Coming soon". At this width both notes fit on one line, so the Navigation section does not move.

accepted_deviations.as_given: A new "NOTIFICATIONS" section with one "Notifications" switch (off) sits between the Navigation section and the New chat defaults section. So New chat defaults sits lower, or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: In both pictures the screen ends inside the Navigation section at the Projects row, so the new section is below the visible area.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Notifications switch moved to that section: the desktop rail no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" switch at its bottom, and the More drawer no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" row at its end. So the drawer is shorter and its top edge sits lower.
accepted_deviations.note: This tablet layout has a bottom tab bar, with no desktop rail, and the More drawer is closed in both pictures.

limits: Each half of the side-by-side image is 1180 px wide and may be shown to me scaled down, so I could not check differences under about 2 px. The diff image shows a faint outline on all text and controls, which looks like antialiasing. Its only strong difference is in the Text size control and note.
Content below the Projects row in the Navigation section is outside both pictures, so I could not check it.
